 Job Scan Home / Income Tax / Income Tax, GST and Corporate Compliance Calendar for November 2026 [PDF Download] Income Tax Law Report Income Tax, GST and Corporate Compliance Calendar for November 2026 [PDF Download]
 A comprehensive guide to key statutory filing deadlines, tax payment obligations and compliance extensions applicable to taxpayers, businesses and companies in November 2026.
 By  Kavi Priya · 1 Nov 2026, 10:55 am IST 7′ read Save Get the day's tax rulings in your inbox 
 Email address Subscribe × November 2026 brings important compliance deadlines for income tax returns, TDS/TCS payments, GST filings and corporate annual returns. Recently, the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) extended the income tax return filing deadline for specified assessees whose accounts are required to be audited from October 31, 2026 to November 21, 2026 for Assessment Year 2026-27.
 The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) through General Circular No. 05/2026 dated October 24, 2026 has also provided relief for annual corporate filings. Specified financial statement forms may be filed until December 31, 2026 and annual return forms until January 31, 2027 without additional filing fees.

 7 November 2026
 TDS/TCS Deposit
 Also Read 10-year ITR leak to Private Party: Madras HC Directs PCIT to Decide Taxpayer’s Complaint Deposit tax deducted or collected during October 2026. Government offices paying without a challan must deposit the tax on the same day.
 7 November 2026
 Form No. 127
 Upload declarations received from buyers during October 2026 under the Income-tax Rules, 2026.
 14 November 2026
 Form No. 132
 Issue TDS certificates for specified tax deductions made during September 2026 under Sections 393 and 395 of the Income-tax Act, 2025.
 15 November 2026
 Form No. 1
 Stock exchanges must furnish statements concerning client-code modifications made during October 2026.
 15 November 2026
 Form No. 137
 Government offices must furnish the statement for TDS/TCS paid without production of a challan during October 2026.
 15 November 2026
 Form No. 131
 Issue applicable quarterly TDS certificates for non-salary deductions for the quarter ending September 30, 2026.
 15 November 2026
 Form No. 133
 Issue TCS certificates for the quarter ending September 30, 2026.
 21 November 2026
 Income Tax Return (ITR)
 Extended deadline for filing ITR for AY 2026-27 by specified companies, assessees whose accounts require audit, partners of audited firms and applicable spouses, excluding cases governed by Section 92E.
 21 November 2026
 Forms 10H, 10CCD and 10CCE
 Furnish applicable certificates for authors and patentees claiming deductions under Sections 80QQB and 80RRB.
 21 November 2026
 Form 10E
 Furnish the prescribed form for claiming relief under Section 89 in respect of salary arrears or advance salary.
 21 November 2026
 Form 10-EE
 Furnish the statement for claiming relief under Section 89A concerning eligible foreign retirement benefit accounts.
 21 November 2026
 Form 10CCF
 Furnish the report certifying deductions claimed under Section 80LA for FY 2025-26, where applicable.
 21 November 2026
 Forms 10-II, 10-IG, 10-IH and 10-IK
 Furnish applicable statements concerning exempt income and income taxable at concessional rates under Sections 10 and 115AD.
 21 November 2026
 Forms 10BBD and 10BBC
 Furnish applicable statements and certificates concerning specified funds, eligible investments and notified pension funds.
 21 November 2026
 Forms 10BA and 10-IA
 Furnish applicable declarations and certificates for deductions under Sections 80GG, 80DD and 80U.
 21 November 2026
 Forms 3CFA and 62
 Furnish applicable patent royalty tax-option statements and prescribed certificates concerning production levels following amalgamation.
 21 November 2026
 Form 10BC
 Furnish the prescribed audit report and annexure by an electoral trust.
 21 November 2026
 Scientific Research Statements
 Applicable research associations, companies, universities, colleges and institutions must furnish prescribed statements.
 30 November 2026
 Form No. 141
 Furnish challan-cum-statement for specified TDS transactions undertaken during October 2026 under Section 393(1) of the Income-tax Act, 2025.
 30 November 2026
 Income Tax Return (ITR)
 Deadline for AY 2026-27 returns by assessees required to furnish a transfer pricing report under Section 92E, including applicable partners and spouses.
 30 November 2026
 Form 3CEAA
 Furnish the prescribed report by a constituent entity of an international group for the relevant accounting year, where applicable.
 30 November 2026
 Form 3CLA
 Furnish audited accounts to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research for eligible claims under Section 35(2AB).
 30 November 2026
 Form 5C
 Furnish details concerning capital gains attribution under Section 45(4) following reconstitution of a firm, AOP or BOI.
 30 November 2026
 Form 64
 Furnish the statement concerning income distributed by venture capital companies or venture capital funds during FY 2025-26.
 30 November 2026
 Form 49C
 Furnish the prescribed statement by a non-resident having a liaison office in India for FY 2025-26.
 30 November 2026
 Other Applicable Forms
 Furnish relevant Forms 10H, 10E, 10CCF, 10BA, 10-IA, 10BBD, 10-IH, 10-IK and 3CFA, where the applicable return-filing deadline is November 30, 2026.
